item.title: UNDP and DFINITY Explore Sovereign Cloud and Decentralized AI
item.summary: The United Nations Development Programme and the DFINITY Foundation have entered a partnership to explore sovereign cloud infrastructure and decentralized artificial intelligence for public-sector and development initiatives, according to an announcement. The collaboration will examine how emerging technologies can support digital transformation across governments, civil society organizations and UNDP programs.
